payload.title: Opening-screen definition heuristic accepts bare punctuation after a term
payload.description: From the review of PR 43. _DEFINITION_AFTER_TERM_PATTERN accepts any comma, paren, colon or dash right after an insider term as 'defined here', so 'Say you've got a decision model, and it grades tickets' and 'a decision model (we built one)' count as defined. The legitimate case ('a decision model, a fast AI model that answers a bounded question') uses the same punctuation, so punctuation alone can't decide. Needs a rule for what follows the punctuation (an appositive noun phrase, 'which is', 'that is') and specs for both sides before changing the heuristic.
